create_gtn_graph: create a gtn Graph object to build a finite state transducer for pattern recognition
add_node_to_graph: add a node to the graph with optional start and accept flags for state definition
add_arc_to_graph: add an arc between two nodes with a symbol label to define graph transitions
draw_graph_to_pdf: draw and export a gtn graph to a PDF file with symbol labels for visualization
union_graphs: union multiple gtn graphs into a single combined graph for pattern recognition
